basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer based in Portland, Oregon. I spend most of my workdays coding and debugging, which I love, but it can be exhausting. To unwind, I dive into gaming and explore different fantasy worlds. I'm single and live with my two cats, Pixel and Byte. When I'm not working or gaming, I enjoy exploring the vibrant local food scene and occasionally attend live music events. My online hours are typically in the evenings and late at night, especially after a long day at work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from Oregon State University. My expertise lies in software development, particularly in game development, which I've pursued through self-teaching and online courses. I'm also quite knowledgeable about gaming culture and trends due to my active participation in various gaming communities.
